ManagementDetails: Provide 'alleyways' (pathways of 30 cm every 2 meters in north-south direction) to improve sunlight penetration and air aeration, making microclimate unsuitable for hovers. Drain standing water for 3-4 days during peak tillering.

Conserve natural mirid predators (Cyrtorhinus lividipennis) and spiders (Lycosa pseudoannulata). Spray botanical Neem Oil 1500 ppm @ 3 ml/L or Azadirachtin 1% @ 1.5 ml/L directing nozzle strictly to the base of the plant.
Spray Pymetrozine 50% WDG @ 0.6 g/L (120 g/acre) OR Triflumezopyrim 10% SC @ 0.48 ml/L (94 ml/acre) targeting the plant base. Avoid synthetic pyrethroids as they cause pest resurgence.
Seed treatment with Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 2.0 g/kg seed or Carbendazim 50% WP @ 2.0 g/kg seed before sowing. Avoid excessive split application of nitrogenous fertilizers.
Spray Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6 g/L (120 g/acre) OR Isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5 ml/L (300 ml/acre). For neck blast, ensure prophylactic spray at 5% panicle emergence.

Foliar application of Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4 21%) @ 5.0 g/L + Lime @ 2.5 g/L (or 2% Urea) in 200 L water/acre. Repeat spray 10-12 days later if symptoms persist. Basal: Apply ZnSO4 @ 25 kg/ha before last puddling.
Install FAW pheromone lures/traps @ 5-8 traps/acre for pest monitoring. Hand collection and destruction of cream-colored egg masses and young congregating caterpillars in whorls.
Apply Bacillus thuringiensis (Bt) kurstaki formulation @ 2 g/L OR Nomuraea rileyi / Metarhizium anisopliae formulation @ 5 g/L in whorls in early morning or late evening.
Whorl application: Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.4 ml/L (80 ml/acre) OR Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4 g/L (80 g/acre) using a single nozzle directed deep into the plant central whorl.
Spray Propiconazole 25% EC (Tilt) @ 1.0 ml/L (200 ml/acre) OR Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1.0 ml/L dissolved in 200 liters of water at first detection of stripe rust pustules.
Install Helicoverpa armigera pheromone traps @ 5 traps/acre. Release Trichogramma chilonis @ 50,000/ha at weekly intervals (3-4 times). Spray HaNPV 250 LE/acre with 0.1% teepol in evening.
Spray Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC @ 0.3 ml/L (60 ml/acre) OR Flubendiamide 39.35% SC @ 0.2 ml/L (40 ml/acre) in 200 L water. Rotate chemistries to prevent insecticide resistance.
